fcc_description:
Given a string date in the format YYYY-MM-DD, return the day of the week.

Valid return days are:

  • "Sunday"
  • "Monday"
  • "Tuesday"
  • "Wednesday"
  • "Thursday"
  • "Friday"
  • "Saturday"

Be sure to ignore time zones.
